issues.where: frames 615-5006 across sheet-01.png to sheet-04.png (all planet holds and cycles)
issues.what: every stop from Mercury through Neptune repeats the exact same 570-frame pacing cycle and dead-center bullseye hold framing with an on-axis zoom
issues.fix: vary hold compositions across stops (rule-of-thirds offsets, crescent/terminator angles, flyby arcs, high/low latitudes, moon-led framings) and modulate segment durations so major worlds like Earth, Jupiter, and Saturn breathe longer than brief inner/outer flybys

issues.where: frames 5145-5324 (and up to 5362 in sheet-04.png, ending.lookback)
issues.what: camera is nearly frozen for over 200 frames on a mostly black frame where Neptune's unlit disk is barely legible at far left and the Sun dot sits motionless
issues.fix: add a continuous slow backward/lateral camera drift around Neptune's lit crescent and ring arc so parallax actively reveals and frames the distant Sun rather than holding static dead space

issues.what: Mars whips off-screen in 6 frames (2752-2758) while still large, leaving ~20 frames of empty starfield before Jupiter scales straight out of the dead center on a rigid z-axis push
issues.fix: smooth the departure pan away from Mars, introduce a continuous curving camera pan/arc across the Mars-to-Jupiter gap, and bring Jupiter in off-center with lateral parallax rather than a pure center zoom

issues.what: camera is almost completely static across 180 frames on a symmetrical dead-center framing of the sunspot and magnetic loop
issues.fix: introduce a clear lateral/orbital glide or rising tilt across the solar limb over frames 0-179 to establish scale, parallax, and opening momentum before pulling back to the full Sun

issues.what: camera zooms flatly on-axis into Mars (pushing Phobos awkwardly out the bottom border at 2400-2416), snaps pitch abruptly into the canyon horizon at 2465 while overshooting/stretching the bottom frame edge, and then stalls nearly static through 2489
issues.fix: arc past Phobos and pitch smoothly toward the limb during entry so the orbital dive matches the canyon horizon angle, keep the terrain camera inside plate bounds at 2465, and maintain forward glide across 2465-2489

issues.what: end-of-hold push-ins clip planet poles and ring tips tangentially against top/bottom borders while leaving wide empty margins on left and right
issues.fix: either frame wide enough to keep full disks and ring systems cleanly inside safe margins on portrait holds, or push asymmetrically into a deliberate close limb/feature composition

issues.what: nearly every terrain stop places a level horizon band across the upper quarter of the frame with minimal camera motion
issues.fix: vary terrain camera altitude, roll/bank, horizon height, and sweep direction from stop to stop (e.g., steeper vortex look-downs on Jupiter/Neptune, ring-plane skim on Saturn, low canyon skim on Mars)
